assets.name: Open orbit
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original logo concept for Orbit
Primary request: Create ONE polished original concept logo for "Orbit", a local macOS workspace that brings developers' projects, repositories, tasks and documents together.
Scene/backdrop: pure white square canvas.
Style/medium: flat black vector-like logo design, crisp edges, carefully balanced negative space, scalable simple geometry.
Text (verbatim): "Orbit" — capital O then lowercase r b i t. Spell it exactly. No other text.
Composition/framing: one centered logo with generous whitespace. For symbol concepts, place the substantial symbol above a smaller crisp modern sans-serif Orbit wordmark in black; wordmark-only concept uses the custom wordmark as the focal point. Keep all elements fully inside the canvas.
Constraints: one design only, black ink on pure white; strong silhouette readable at small sizes; original design; no mockup, texture, lighting, shadow, gradient, 3D, additional panels, slogan, watermark, explanatory labels or concept numbers. No literal planets, rockets, stars, atom or planetary rings.
Concept direction: A bold circular O interrupted by one carefully placed square satellite at about two o'clock. The square is a project tile on a circular path, rather than a planet. Strong asymmetrical silhouette; simple precise geometry.
